title: ClinicOS verification request
description: Future ClinicOS components can submit this payload to POST /api/verify. MedGuard does not connect to ClinicOS or to production patient databases. Records in the demo are synthetic.

requirements.description: Security requirements supplied by the caller. Stored with the run and shown to the independent reviewer. They do not replace MedGuard policy.

policy_version.description: Requested policy version. If it is not the loaded pack, the decision is REVIEW.
